_doc: Per-slug canonical override map for svizzera-section blog articles (issue #3010 item 1, follow-up to PR #3000 'de-collide duplicate svizzera localized slugs'). Used by build-plugins/ogPagesPlugin.ts (svizzera section) to consolidate 3 near-duplicate article pairs onto a single winner per Google canonical semantics. Key = page slug (last URL segment, no leading slash) of the shadowed (lower-authority) variant, one entry per locale. Value = absolute canonical URL of the authoritative/winner variant in the SAME locale. Both pages stay live (no removal/noindex, per the repo anti-cut rule) — only the shadowed variant's <link rel="canonical"> and og:url point at the winner. The shadowed pages remain in sitemap-blog-ch.xml/RSS on purpose (unlike data/job-canonical-overrides.json, which drops overridden slugs from the sitemap) so they stay fully indexable-with-a-hint rather than de-listed. Source: issue #3010, 2026-07-02.
